claim: AI models that combine multiple modality data (e.g., via deep learning) improve understanding of complex biological systems and diseases, and can discover new targets for drug intervention.
falsifier: The claim can be tested by applying multi-modal deep learning models to biological datasets and evaluating their ability to uncover novel insights or validate known biological relationships and target discoveries.

conditions: Availability of heterogeneous data from multiple modalities (e.g., genomics, proteomics, metabolomics)
Deep learning models are capable of integrating and analyzing such data
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported system, task, population, and conditions; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: AI models using multiple–understanding of complex biological principle
